requirements.quote: A conformant Client MUST support the use of one or more underlying transport protocols that provide an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes from the Client to Server and Server to Client [MQTT-7.1.2-1]. However conformance does not depend on it supporting any specific transport protocols. A Client MAY support any of the transport protocols listed in Section 4.2, or any other transport protocol that meets the requirements of [MQTT-7.1.2-1].
requirements.required_behavior: Support use of at least one qualifying underlying transport protocol.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A Client supporting zero qualifying transports is nonconformant.
requirements.why_checkable: The Client's available transport implementations can be enumerated and the count checked against one.

requirements.quote: A conformant Client MUST support the use of one or more underlying transport protocols that provide an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes from the Client to Server and Server to Client [MQTT-7.1.2-1]. However conformance does not depend on it supporting any specific transport protocols. A Client MAY support any of the transport protocols listed in Section 4.2, or any other transport protocol that meets the requirements of [MQTT-7.1.2-1].
requirements.condition: For at least one underlying transport protocol supported by a conformant Client
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not rely solely on transports that can reorder MQTT stream bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: Known byte sequences can be transmitted and receive order compared.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not rely solely on transports that silently lose MQTT stream bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: Known byte sequences can be transmitted and checked for complete delivery or explicit connection failure.

requirements.quote: A conformant Client MUST support the use of one or more underlying transport protocols that provide an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes from the Client to Server and Server to Client [MQTT-7.1.2-1].
